en-GB.title: Cash Flow vs. Appreciation: Two Goals, One Property
en-GB.summary: Cash Flow vs. Appreciation: Two Goals, One Property
en-GB.body: Real estate can target current cash flow, long-term appreciation, or a blend. Strong cash-flow properties may be found where rent is high relative to purchase price, while high-growth markets can offer appreciation potential with thinner current income. Neither objective is inherently superior. The investor's time horizon, liquidity needs, reserves and risk tolerance determine which combination fits. Level 2 analysis identifies what a property actually does for the investor instead of relying on one attractive number.
